pieces.title: Batons in the air
pieces.caption: The nineteen handoffs open on the board today, each shown by its page's avatar with how long it has been in the air. The oldest is three weeks. *What is real and what is a choice:* Read from the board's own handoff list on 2026-11-10. An open baton is not a fumble; that word is for one claimed and never closed. *Leaking in:* The nineteen pages carrying a baton.
